 Order

This appeal is filed under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act being aggrieved with the award dated 09.01.2015 passed by 12th Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Bhopal whereby the tribunal has awarded a sum of Rs.14,13,600/- in favour of the claimants on account of injuries sustained by him.

entities.text: 12th Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Bhopal
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for the appellant submitted that during pendency of the appeal, the claimant has died,
therefore, the claim should now be treated as death claim and award should be revised and enhanced.

Shri T.S. Lamba, learned counsel appearing for the insurance company submitted that the trial has awarded sufficient compensation holding that the claimant had sustained 95%
permanent disability.
Having heard learned counsel for the parties and after going through the impugned award, it is apparent that the claims tribunal on various heads awarded just and proper compensation.
It cannot be said that there is any infirmity in the impugned award warranting any interference in this appeal.
Accordingly, the appeal being devoid of merits stands dismissed.
Record of the tribunal be sent back.

(VIVEK AGARWAL) JUDGE ks Rajesh Panthi (Dead) Through Lrs Deep ... vs Revaram on 16 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/97963600/
